questions.topic: Verb position in the main clause

stimulus.body: In einer Arbeitsnotiz zu diesem Punkt heißt es: «Ich gehe heute ins Kino mit meinen Freunden.» Vier Aussagen werden angeboten; nur eine wird durch den Text tatsächlich gestützt.

options.text: Heute ich gehe ins Kino mit meinen Freunden
options.misconception: puts the subject before the inverted verb

options.text: Ins Kino ich gehe heute mit meinen Freunden
options.misconception: strands the verb at the end of the clause

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: in a main clause the finite verb occupies the second position. On that basis "Ich gehe heute ins Kino mit meinen Freunden" is the supported choice. Option B ("Ich heute gehe ins Kino mit meinen Freunden") fails because it places the verb after the time adverbial; Option C ("Heute ich gehe ins Kino mit meinen Freunden") fails because it puts the subject before the inverted verb; Option D ("Ins Kino ich gehe heute mit meinen Freunden") fails because it strands the verb at the end of the clause.

answer.exemplar: Use accusative for movement toward a destination and dative for a static location, as in 'in den Park' versus 'im Park'.

questions.explanation: Close reading of the note yields this rule: movement toward takes accusative; static location takes dative. On that basis "Use accusative for movement toward a destination and dative for a static location, as in 'in…" is the supported choice.

stimulus.body: Der folgende Auszug dient der Überprüfung des Verständnisses dieser Form. «Grammatical gender is independent of biology.» « Mädchen » Von vier Antworten passt allein diejenige, die sich aus dem Text ergibt.

questions.stem: Mit dem Hinweis «Explain noun gender assignment / Grammatical vs natural gender. / Noun gender»: welche Option wird vom Text wirklich gedeckt?

options.text: It is actually feminine in all contexts
options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "It is actually feminine in all contexts" for the governing rule

options.text: Grammatical gender is independent of biology
It has no gender at all
options.misconception: selects "It has no gender at all" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: grammatical gender need not match biology. On that basis "Grammatical gender is independent of biology" is the supported choice. Option A ("It becomes masculine in plural") fails because it confuses gender with number; Option B ("It is actually feminine in all contexts") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "It is actually feminine in all contexts" for the governing rule; Option D ("It has no gender at all") fails because it selects "It has no gender at all" where noun gender requires a different condition.

stimulus.body: Der folgende Auszug dient der Überprüfung des Verständnisses dieser Form. «For known or specific nouns.» Von vier Antworten passt allein diejenige, die sich aus dem Text ergibt.

questions.stem: Mit dem Hinweis «Explain definite article usage / Specificity. / Articles»: welche Option wird vom Text wirklich gedeckt?

options.misconception: reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: definite articles mark known or specific nouns. On that basis "For known or specific nouns" is the supported choice. Option A ("Never with proper names") fails because it reverses the direction of the reasoning that settles articles; Option B ("Only for plural nouns") fails because it restricts articles to plural; Option C ("Only in questions") fails because it restricts articles to questions.
